prompt:
Create a high-fidelity mobile landing page for the fictional Minsk coffee roastery «Кварта», edge to edge on a 9:16 portrait canvas, showing the first viewport and the beginning of the next section. Russian text must be crisp and readable. No browser window, phone frame, or staged desk surrounding the webpage.

This is the digital noticeboard of a friendly neighborhood workshop: the page itself is the board, and the order slip is a working part of it. Deep bottle-green painted surfaces, off-white uncoated notices and a restrained melon print color form the reusable visual language. Use expressive sturdy Cyrillic sans lettering with clear ordinary text; keep the board composition coherent rather than scattering tilted cards. One closely observed still life of coffee packaging makes the actual product tangible.

Kvarta roasts small 5 kg batches on Thursdays and delivers around Minsk on Fridays. The reading order is the local workshop's invitation, the weekly schedule together with the actual coffee offer, a directly usable callback slip, then the beginning of the origin list. Use the exact copy «Кварта», «Ваш кофе. Соседняя обжарка.», «В четверг обжариваем — в пятницу привозим», «Кофе от 26 BYN», «Подписка · 54 BYN / месяц».

Show labelled controls «Имя», «Телефон», «Разовый заказ», «Подписка», «Вопрос», optional «Комментарий» and an unmistakable «Оставить заявку» button. Include «Перезвоним и поможем с выбором». The frame has navigation «Кофе», «Подписка», «Доставка»; the lower edge starts «Что обжариваем» with «Эфиопия Иргачеффе · 250 г · 32 BYN». Preserve generous readable sizing and one dominant focal move. No invented claims or contact details.
